taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: leaves scattered, 7-30 cm.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: leaves 7-30 cm.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: stems long-creeping, 0.7-3 mm diam.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: a fern.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: the fronds stay on through the year, curling in drought and opening after rain, as lip ferns' do.

traits.reproduction.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: sori more or less continuous around segment margins; sporangia containing 32 spores.

traits.perennation.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: stems long-creeping, scaly.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: stems long-creeping; Hoshizaki and Moran (2001 p. 242): rhizome long-creeping.

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: stems long-creeping, the leaves scattered along them.

traits.leaf_posture.note: Fronds stiffly erect, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 268301191, 265729568, 18735718, 323773489, 270922834, 91883660, 262074746, 35026541): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: blades 4 cm to 15 cm long, a little over half the 7-30 cm leaf (FNA), as in the photos.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001) p. 242, Cheilanthes lindheimeri: the habit drawing shows a long hairy stipe longer than the blade; 3 cm to 15 cm drawn.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: blade oblong-lanceolate to ovate-deltate, 4-pinnate at base, 2-5 cm wide.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: blade 4-pinnate at base.

traits.division_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: blade 4-pinnate at base; pinnae not articulate.

traits.division_order.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: blade 4-pinnate at base.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: blade oblong-lanceolate to ovate-deltate; the photos show the narrower outline.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: the adaxial blade surface appears to be densely gray tomentose, an illusion of the curly cilia of the costal scales; grey-green in the photos; sRGB by eye.

traits.stipe_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: petiole usually dark brown, rounded adaxially; sRGB by eye.

traits.stipe_scales.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: stem scales often deciduous on older portions; rachis with scattered linear-lanceolate scales and sparse pubescence.

traits.sorus_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: sori more or less continuous around segment margins.

traits.indusium.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cheilanthes lindheimeri: false indusia marginal, weakly differentiated, 0.05-0.25 mm wide.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for fairy swords against the template, a small lip fern of dry rock: fronds rising one by one along a long-creeping rhizome (the subclass's rules for rhizome_habit), slender stipes, pinnae angled up (pinna_angle 55). Not fitted to measurements.

appearance.note: By eye from the photos (observations 268301191, 265729568, 18735718, 323773489, 270922834, 91883660, 262074746, 35026541): erect, narrow, finely divided fronds that look grey and woolly, on dark stalks scattered along a creeping rhizome among rocks.

allometry.note: 0.15 m tall at 4 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added for the Saguaro desert scene (west bajada of Saguaro National Park's Tucson Mountain District, about 750 m), batch s1b (2026-10-19): sizes and forms from FEIS, Kearney and Peebles, Hitchcock and Flora of North America, counts and colours from photos.
